.facility-card-container {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 20px;
  padding: 20px;
  max-width: 1200px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.facility-card {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 8px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
  background: #fff;
}

.facility-image {
  position: relative;
  height: 250px;
  background-size: cover;
  background-position: center;
  border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.facility-image::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
  border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 1;
}

.facility-image:hover::before {
  opacity: 1;
}

.facility-image:hover {
  transform: scale(1.05);
}

.button-container {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 20px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  text-align: center;
  z-index: 2;
  width: 100%;
}

.btn-primary {
  background-color: #BA1C21; /* Site theme color */
  color: #FFFFFF !important;
  padding: 10px 20px;
  text-decoration: none;
  border-radius: 4px;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: bold;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
  display: inline-block;
}

.btn-primary:hover {
  background-color: #003058; /* Darker blue on hover */
  transform: scale(1.1);
}

.facility-card h3 {
  margin: 15px 0;
  font-size: 1.2rem;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 0 10px 15px;
  color: #222;
}

/* Site Header Layout for Desktop */
.site-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 20px 40px;
  background-color: #f9f9f9;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.page-title {
  font-size: 24px;
  font-weight: bold;
  margin: 0;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
}

.facility-nav {
  flex: 0 0 300px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  align-items: center;
}

.facility-select {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 280px;
  padding: 10px 15px;
  font-size: 16px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  border: 1px solid #ccc;
}

/* Responsive Styles */

/* Tablet and smaller */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .facility-card-container {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    max-width: 700px;
    padding: 15px;
  }

  .site-header {
    padding: 15px 20px;
  }

  .facility-nav {
    flex: 1 1 100%;
    justify-content: center;
    margin-top: 10px;
  }

  .facility-select {
    max-width: 100%;
  }
}

/* Mobile */
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .site-header {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;
    padding: 10px 15px;
  }

  .page-title {
    font-size: 20px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }

  .facility-nav {
    width: 100%;
    justify-content: center;
    margin-bottom: 15px;
  }

  .facility-select {
    max-width: 100%;
    width: 100%;
    font-size: 16px;
    padding: 12px;
  }

  .facility-card-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center; /* Center cards horizontally */
    padding: 10px 10px 30px 10px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  .facility-card {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 350px; /* Limit max width for neat centering */
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
  }

  .facility-image {
    height: 200px;
  }
}

.site-footer {
  background-color: #f5f5f5;
  padding: 20px 0;
  text-align: center;
  border-top: 1px solid #ddd;
  margin-top: 40px;
}

.site-footer .footer-content p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: #666;

        var CookieDate = new Date;
        CookieDate.setTime(CookieDate.getTime() + 1 * 3600 * 1000 * 24);
        document.cookie = "sidearm-adblock-banner_consent=true; expires=\"" + CookieDate.toGMTString() + "\";";
        document.querySelector(".bwbbhcytv").remove();

                document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {

                                text.setAttribute('aria-live', 'off');

                            });
                        }

                });
